stem:
With reference to the mineral production in Bihar, consider the following statements:
1. Rohtas has the highest deposit of pyrites.
2. Limestone is found in Kaimur (Bhabhua), Munger and Rohtas districts.
3. Gold deposits are found in Jamui district.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: All the statements given in the question are correct. Rohtas has the largest reserves of pyrite. Limestone is found in Kaimur (Bhabua), Munger and Rohtas districts. Gold reserves are found in Jamui district. Therefore, the correct answer is option (d).

stem: Coal Reserves in Bihar on January 1, 2003 is (in million tonnes) –
expl: On 1 January, 2003, the estimated coal reserve in Bihar was 16 crore tonnes (160 million tonnes). According to the Indian Minerals Yearbook, 2023, the coal reserves in Bihar as of 1 April 2022 were 4437 million tonnes.

stem: The estimated coal reserves in Bihar are –
expl: After the formation of Jharkhand as a separate state from Bihar, Bihar’s natural resources declined significantly. According to the Indian Minerals Yearbook, 2023, Bihar has coal reserves of 4437 million tonnes (as of 1 April, 2022). At the time of the question, the estimated coal reserves in Bihar were 16 crore tonnes.

stem:
Which of the following is/are largely mined in Bihar?
I. Coal II. Iron
III. Manganese IV. Petroleum
Choose the correct answer from the following :
expl: During the relevant period, coal, iron ore and manganese— all three—were found. Petroleum was not found here. Therefore, in the context of undivided Bihar during that period, the correct answer was option (c). According to the Indian Minerals Yearbook, 2023, minerals produced in Bihar include—coal, mica, quartz/silica sand, quartzite, talc/ soapstone/steatite, bauxite, china clay, feldspar, fire clay, gold, granite, iron ore (hematite + magnetite), lead-zinc, pyrite and limestone.

stem: Among the following pairs of mineral and district, which one is correctly matched?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: According to the Indian Minerals Yearbook, 2024, limestone is found in Kaimur (Bhabua), Munger and Rohtas districts; mica in Nawada district; quartzite in Lakhisarai, Munger and Nalanda districts; and lead-zinc in Banka and Rohtas districts.

stem: Iron ore is found in Jharkhand in the district –
expl: During the relevant period, in the context of undivided Bihar, the correct answer was option (d). In 1990, Singhbhum district was divided into East Singhbhum and West Singhbhum. According to the Indian Minerals Yearbook, 2024, Bihar has iron ore reserves of 49439 thousand tonnes (hematite + magnetite).

stem: In India, Bihar is the largest producer of –
expl: During the relevant period, in undivided Bihar (including Jharkhand), mica had the highest production. According to the Indian Minerals Yearbook, 2023, Bihar is a leading state in pyrite reserves. Andhra Pradesh holds the leading position in mica production.

stem: Which district of Bihar has mica deposits?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: Mica reserves are found in Nawada district of Bihar.

stem: In the production of the following in India, Bihar has a monopoly in –
expl: At the time of the question, Bihar had a monopoly in the production of pyrite in India. In Bihar, 94 percent of the country’s pyrite reserves are found.

stem: Gold is found in which district of Bihar?
expl: The entire recorded gold ore resource of Bihar is associated with Jamui district. Indian Minerals Year Book 2024, As of 1 April 2020, the total gold ore (primary) reserves/resources in Bihar are recorded as 222,884,860 tonnes.

expl: The entire recorded gold ore resource of Bihar is associated with Jamui district. Indian Minerals Year Book 2024, As of 1 April 2020, the total gold ore (primary) reserves/resources in Bihar are recorded as 222,884,860 tonnes.

stem:
Best mica ore of the world is obtained from –
1. Dhanbad 2. Hazaribagh
3. Jharia 4. Kulti
Select the correct answer from the following codes –
expl: At the time of the question, mica was obtained from Hazaribagh, Giridih, and Koderma. In Bihar, mica reserves are found in Nawada district.

stem: What percentage of the total mineral production in the country is found in Bihar?
expl: In undivided Bihar, Bihar was rich in minerals. After bifurcation, most mineral-rich areas went to Jharkhand. Therefore, Bihar is no longer rich in minerals. At the time of the question, option (a) was the correct answer.

stem: In the production of crude copper in the country, Bihar ranks-
expl: In copper production, the position of the then Bihar was third. Hence, under the then prevailing conditions, the desired answer was option (a). At present, copper is not produced in Bihar. Indian Minerals Year Book 2024, In 2023–24 stood at the top in the production of copper concentrate.

stem: Which is the most important district of Jharkhand in iron ore production?
expl: The Singhbhum region of Jharkhand (East and West Singhbhum districts) holds the most important place in iron-ore production. The iron ore obtained from here is used in the Jamshedpur and Bokaro steel industries. 2023-24 (P), According to the Indian Minerals Yearbook, 2024 Odisha is India’s top iron-ore producing state.

stem: Iron is obtained from which of the following minerals?
expl: Iron is mainly found in four types of ores—(i) Magnetite, (ii) Hematite, (iii) Limonite, and (iv) Siderite. Besides these, iron content is also found in taconite, chamosite, and pyrite. However, since the metal content in these is low, their economic importance is limited.
